data.name: Gersham
data.gender_notes: Gersham is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Gerasimos, which means 'ploughman' or 'farmer'. In the New Testament, there is a character named Gerasimus who welcomed Jesus into his home. Therefore, the name Gersham may symbolize a person who is hospitable, welcoming, and nurturing. The name Gersham carries the meaning “Ploughman, farmer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gersham usually hope their child will grow to embody ploughman, farmer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
